_comment: Verbatim shims written by npm 11.17.0 (cmd-shim 8.0.0) for `npm install -g --ignore-scripts <treepo tarball>` on Windows 11; captured, not generated. JSON keeps the exact bytes (CRLF in .cmd, LF in .ps1) independent of Git line-ending normalization.
cmd:
@ECHO off
GOTO start
:find_dp0
SET dp0=%~dp0
EXIT /b
:start
SETLOCAL
CALL :find_dp0

IF EXIST "%dp0%\node.exe" (
  SET "_prog=%dp0%\node.exe"
) ELSE (
  SET "_prog=node"
  SET PATHEXT=%PATHEXT:;.JS;=;%
)

endLocal & goto #_undefined_# 2>NUL || title %COMSPEC% & "%_prog%"  "%dp0%\node_modules\treepo\dist\bin\treepo.js" %*
